location_exception_reason: MS Security Cabins are industrial/commercial prefabricated structures sold nationwide with standardised specifications; location of manufacture or deployment is not a buyer decision factor. Origin is not GI-tagged or regionally defined.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. The product is a security cabin regardless of seller classification. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' leaves the title complete and accurate.
